title: Playback session start with redacting logs
name: Playback session API

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code handles sensitive data in logs? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
The access_log middleware records request.url.path rather than the full URL. What does that avoid?
choices: Writing query-string values, which can carry tokens or personal data, into the access log.
Extra latency from parsing the URL.

questions.prompt: How does JsonFormatter treat fields passed via extra= when a caller logs?
choices: It copies every non-standard record attribute into the JSON object, so whatever callers put in extra appears in the output unless the filter changed it.
It writes only the message and level.
It writes only fields on an allowlist.
It drops any field whose value is not a string.

questions.prompt: RedactingFilter is added to the root logger's handler in configure_logging. Which records does it process?
choices: Only records from the root logger itself.
Only records at WARNING and above.
Every record that reaches that handler, including those from the streamhub.* loggers, since they propagate to the root.
Only records that include an extra field.
